about: Which colour group of this model's texture is which role, matched by colour (Oklab distance under 0.06). Roles are the standard ones every model shares: the clothing roles headwear, tops, bottoms, footwear and accessory (anything baked into the model, like a bag or a backpack), plus skin, hair and keep (left as authored, like eyes). A one-piece garment is tops with no bottoms; this model has no headwear and no accessory, so a scheme skips them. Both of its shoe colors are footwear. Check at /lab/people?model=casual-man-low with R for false colour; region numbers there follow the detector's order, not this list's. The same garments as casual-man, so the same colours; the remesh has no separate eye colour.
